metadata.description: Agent skills Solidgate engineers use every day: GitLab MR workflow, Go service review, ADRs and design docs, planning, pnpm audit fixes.

plugins.name: mr-toolkit
plugins.description: The whole GitLab merge-request loop from your terminal. /mr-inbox analyzes every MR that needs you in parallel, auto-fixes the safe parts and gives you one decision screen; /mr-review writes a risk brief with a gated auto-approve; /mr-create opens an MR with a reviewer-focused description; /mr-deliver drives an MR to merge; /mr-unblock resolves what blocks a merge; /mr-split turns a big change into a git-spice stack; /mr-nudge DMs reviewers; /mr-to-review and /mr-ready show your queues.

plugins.name: go-deep-service-review
plugins.description: Multi-agent review of a Go service for a closed set of production defects: context propagation, IO without timeouts, decisions on untyped errors, unchecked batch partial failures (e.g. SQS), resource lifecycle (tx rollback, rows.Err, unclosed bodies/rows/readers), goroutines that cannot stop, app setup init/close order, SQL write pitfalls. You pick the checks; every finding carries its verification evidence.

plugins.name: engineering-toolkit
plugins.description: Engineering practice in the repo: ADR and design-document authoring that interviews you one decision at a time, setup of folders and AGENTS.md rules for AI artifacts (plans, specs, ideas) with migration of existing records.

plugins.name: nodejs-toolkit
plugins.description: Fixes pnpm 12 audit vulnerabilities in a fixed order — drop, update, override, ignore — after first re-checking whether existing overrides and ignores are still needed. Settings go to pnpm-workspace.yaml; ignores by GHSA.

plugins.name: planning-toolkit
plugins.description: Problem-to-announcement planning for engineering teams: IF–THEN–BECAUSE hypotheses tied to DORA, SPACE, security or product metrics, lean milestone roadmaps, critics that hold both to the same rules, and contributor-facing Slack posts for shipped platform changes.
